intent: After exact root retirement, cancel/clear/restart matching search generation so queued old Batch/Error/Finished cannot publish under the same logical key. Ordinary changes, rescan flags, other roots/projects and mode/config removal preserve ongoing search.
implementation: Background Project event classification and existing registered-root dev/ino comparison retain exact paths; Change.merge preserves them; production per-project Git-change ingestion schedules fresh search immediately. No synchronous filesystem work added to UI.
runtime: All new owning bodies/compiles/native/UX/BeforeAfter/performance UNRUN; source-only freeze.
scope_limits: No1871 merge, no new timer or generic-change cancellation.
Missed/ambiguous watcher events remain outside established retirement evidence.
Host+UI isolated boundaries and actual native before/after fullflow plus independent UX review required before ready.
correction: Visible Retry search control on errors dispatches captured generation; only matching current error/root/context and nonmodal current query may reschedule. Query/options/root preserved; old Retry/Error cannot affect newer search. No automatic retry loop or generic-change restart.

original82_UX_HOLD.scope: Delayed-root error lacked recovery action; old verdict preserved, not transferred.
